scenario.name: Easy Static
scenario.description: A single persistent window from INDIA-GAURI: measured persistence 0.90 with 4 regions occupied more than half the time. Activity barely moves, so any scheduler that remembers where it found signal should do well — the control case.

scenario.name: Periodic Challenge
scenario.description: The strongest periodicity measured anywhere in the cache: INDIA-GAURI repeats every 9 steps (0 min) with autocorrelation 0.55. A scheduler that models recurrence should anticipate the next onset instead of rediscovering it.

scenario.name: High Noise
scenario.description: The lowest-contrast real window available (INDIA-GAURI: mean cell sits -0.77 dB from its own decision threshold, 95th percentile only 0.5 dB above it) seen through a receiver at 1.5 dB of dwell noise instead of the usual 0.4. Almost everything sits near the boundary, so confident detection and honest uncertainty pull apart.

scenario.name: Sudden Shift
scenario.description: Phase A is EGYPT-Alexandria at 33.6% occupancy; at the halfway point the environment becomes SWISS-Landschlacht at 29.8%. The two activity profiles correlate at only -0.45, so almost nothing the scheduler learned in phase A still applies in phase B. Both halves are real recordings from different receivers and bands; only the splice point is our choice, which is what makes recovery time measurable.

scenario.name: Recurring Environment
scenario.description: A -> B -> A'. Phase A is EGYPT-Alexandria; phase B switches to SWISS-Landschlacht, whose activity profile correlates with A at only -0.37; phase A' returns to EGYPT-Alexandria 43 minutes later, a window whose profile still correlates with A at +0.94 — the same environment, genuinely drifted rather than replayed. A memory-free policy has to rediscover A from scratch.

scenario.name: Extreme Budget Constraint
scenario.description: INDIA-GAURI with 48 intermittently active regions, but only enough sensing budget for 35% of the steps. Every observation has to be justified, which is where information value stops being a nicety.

scenario.name: Unseen Generalization Test
scenario.description: Held-out receivers only: SWISS-MUHEN then MRO, both flagged 'unseen' in the station catalogue and never used to tune anything — different bands, different hardware, different continents, profiles correlating at -0.37. The honest test of whether a scheduler learned scheduling or learned one recording.
